4.source: relic set 107 (熔岩锻铸的火匠 / Firesmith of Lava-Forging), 4-piece: 「使装备者战技造成的伤害提高#1[i]%，并使施放终结技后的下一次攻击造成的火属性伤害提高#2[i]%。」 param = [0.12, 0.12]
4.note: The first sentence: a scoped boost on Skill damage, unconditional and with no duration stated, so `permanent`. (The whole 4-piece is ability-only -- its `properties` is empty, so nothing here is duplicated from the data path.)

4.source: relic set 107 (熔岩锻铸的火匠 / Firesmith of Lava-Forging), 4-piece: 「并使施放终结技后的下一次攻击造成的火属性伤害提高#2[i]%。」 param = [0.12, 0.12]
4.note: The second sentence: 「施放终结技后的下一次攻击」 is an EVENT, not a turn count, so it is `"until": "next_attack"` -- `turns: 1` would expire on a turn boundary and also survive a turn in which nothing was attacked. ⚠ The scope is the wearer's FIRE damage, not all damage: `FIRE_DAMAGE_BOOST`, so the buff is consumed by the next attack even if that attack is not fire (which is what the sentence says: it is the NEXT attack's fire damage that is raised, not the next fire attack's).
